# Normalize line endings — store text as LF in the repo.
* text=auto eol=lf

# Treat these as text explicitly
*.yml   text eol=lf
*.yaml  text eol=lf
*.conf  text eol=lf
*.xml   text eol=lf
*.sh    text eol=lf
*.md    text eol=lf

# Binary assets — never apply text detection or EOL normalization. Without this,
# `* text=auto` can misclassify a binary (e.g. the house-twin house.glb model,
# whose header looks text-like) and corrupt it by rewriting CR/LF bytes.
*.glb   binary
*.png   binary
*.jpg   binary
*.jpeg  binary
*.gif   binary
*.webp  binary
*.ico   binary
*.pdf   binary
*.zip   binary
*.gz    binary
*.tgz   binary
*.woff  binary
*.woff2 binary
*.ttf   binary
*.otf   binary

# studio:base:start
# synced from jrmoulckers/.github — canonical source; do not edit here
# Normalize every detected text file to LF in the index and working tree.
# Git's automatic text detection leaves binary files byte-for-byte unchanged.
* text=auto eol=lf
# studio:base:end
